svg.title: Ahmed, university student and full-stack developer
svg.desc: Profile widget: about, projects (CYD iPod, uTune Jukebox, Smart Assistive Glasses, PSP YouTube Client, Lecture Management System), tech stack, and contribution activity.

g.text: Embedded systems and AI on ESP32 and Raspberry Pi
Web apps, devices, and everything between
I build practical systems that solve real problems, especially in education and
university life. Most of my work sits where software meets hardware, and I learn
by building. Everything ships under the Utopia Tech name.
An iPod-style music player on the ESP32 Cheap Yellow
Display, with an SD card library and Bluetooth audio.
Tap an RFID card that stores a YouTube link and the
Wearable device for deaf, mute, and blind users with
sign and speech recognition on a Raspberry Pi 5.
Homebrew YouTube app for the PSP, fed by a one-click
PC relay server that transcodes video.
A platform for universities to manage and deliver
Air Guitar Gloves, MeshRide, MidTune, an ESP32-S3 RFID
storage device, and procedural Blender scenes.
